7: intro: Ask Auntie Lam about the strange machine first
auntie: Drop a token into the Neon Dragon machine
portal: Explore the Temple Street night market
market: Visit the rabbit's lantern stall
lantern_stall: Buy a rabbit lantern (1 token)
market: Say hello to the rat in the waistcoat
rat: Thank her and go back to the market
market: Try the claw machine (1 token) → pass
claw_win: Back to the market
market: Walk to the Star Ferry pier
pier: Board the green Star Ferry to Central (tap Octopus card)
ferry: Join the captain in the wheelhouse
ferry_captain: Hop off at Central Pier
central: Climb the steep streets to Man Mo Temple
man_mo: Bow, walk softly and look around
man_mo_calm: Walk along the hill to the Peak Tram → solve the riddle
tram: Feel your way through the dark
tunnel_dark: Climb out onto the Peak
peak_top: Sneak round the back and climb the tower wall
peak_climb: Brush off the leaves and go back to the door
peak_top: Talk to the goat in golden sneakers → solve the riddle
peak_top: Challenge Bolt-Bot to a duel! → flee
central: use Egg Tart
central: Hop on a ding-ding tram
dingding: Ride east to Causeway Bay
causeway_bay: Get a bubble tea (tap Octopus card)
bubble_tea_shop: Back into the crowds
causeway_bay: Walk to the Happy Valley racecourse
happy_valley: Cheer from the stands, then head back
causeway_bay: Walk to Victoria Park
victoria_park: Copy the Tiger's tai chi → pass
causeway_bay: Call up to the fiery bird on the neon sign → solve the riddle
causeway_bay: Hop on a ding-ding tram
dingding: Hop off in Central
central: Find Pig's cha chaan teng, like Auntie Lam said
cha_chaan_teng: Thank Pig and head back out
central: Blow the Silver Whistle on Central Pier
dog: Follow the dog's nose to the Peak Tram
tram: Hold up your rabbit lantern
tunnel_lit: Unlock the door with the brass key → solve the riddle
vault: Race up to the Neon Dragon
dragon_summit: use Mooncake

dragon_summit: use Pineapple Bun
dragon_summit: Hold up the Pearl of Light
